description:
## Goal

Wire up the ecosystem-manager UI to spawn agent-manager investigations when a task execution fails. The agent-manager investigation framework already exists (depth-based: quick/standard/deep, structured markdown output, apply-fixes workflow) — this item adds the missing UI trigger in ecosystem-manager.

## Current State

### What exists in agent-manager:
- `scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/domain/investigation.go` — InvestigationSettings, depth levels, context flags
- `scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/orchestration/investigation.go` — CreateInvestigationRun(), CreateInvestigationApplyRun()
- Depth-based attachment strategy: quick (overview + events), standard (+ diffs), deep (+ historical context)
- Two-stage workflow: investigation agent analyzes → apply agent implements fixes

### What's missing in ecosystem-manager:
- No UI button/action to trigger investigation from a failed task
- No way to view investigation results in ecosystem-manager context
- No linking between failed execution and investigation run

## Implementation

### Task Detail View
- Add "Investigate" button on failed task executions
- Depth selector (quick/standard/deep) with sensible default
- Optional user context input ("What did you notice?")
- Trigger calls agent-manager's investigation API

### Investigation Results View
- Display investigation report (categorization, findings, recommendations) in ecosystem-manager
- Link back to the specific failed execution
- Show "Apply Fixes" action when recommendations include actionable changes

### Execution History Integration
- Track investigation run IDs in execution history
- Show investigation status badge on failed executions (investigated/not investigated)

## Key References

- Agent-manager investigation: `scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/orchestration/investigation.go`
- Ecosystem-manager execution UI: `scenarios/ecosystem-manager/ui/`
- Ecosystem-manager execution manager: `scenarios/ecosystem-manager/api/pkg/queue/execution_manager.go`
name: ecosystem-investigation-ui-wiring
title: Add UI in Ecosystem-Manager to Spawn Agent-Manager Investigations from Failed Tasks
